cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a quiet residential street — a delivery bicycle with a front basket, mailboxes, a stack of boxes at a doorstep and a stone wall
cuts.scene: she is a new courier walking with a small parcel box held low at her side, checking the address
cuts.outfit: a parcel courier look fitted to her body — a fitted short-sleeved courier jacket zipped low over a short skort with sneakers, bare legs, a plain navy cap
